about.title: About Color Picker Tool
about.description: The Color Picker Tool provides an interface for selecting, reviewing, and converting colors across multiple formats. It supports HEX, RGB, HSL, and other color models for design and front-end workflows. It is useful for designers, artists, and developers who need color selection and format conversion in a single interface.

faq.q: What color formats does the color picker support?
faq.a: Our color picker tool supports HEX codes, RGB values, HSL color model, and CSS color names. All formats are displayed simultaneously for easy comparison and copying, making it perfect for web design and graphic design workflows.

faq.q: How does color selection work in this tool?
faq.a: The color picker provides numerical controls for fine-tuning colors. You can enter specific values or use the visual interface to review and compare color selections.

faq.q: Can I save my favorite colors for later use?
faq.a: Yes, the color picker tool includes color history and favorites functionality. You can save your most-used colors and quickly access recent color selections for consistent design workflows.

faq.q: Is this color picker suitable for professional design work?
faq.a: Yes. The color picker supports major color formats, accurate color representation, and precision controls for web design, graphic design, and digital art projects.

faq.q: What's the difference between RGB and HSL color models?
faq.a: RGB uses Red, Green, Blue values (0-255), while HSL uses Hue (0-360°), Saturation (0-100%), and Lightness (0-100%). HSL is more intuitive for color adjustments, while RGB is standard for digital displays.

faq.q: How do I use HEX color codes from the picker?
faq.a: HEX codes start with # followed by 6 characters (e.g., #FF5733). Copy the HEX value from our color picker and paste it directly into CSS, HTML, or design software for consistent color reproduction.
